entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Human of Innistrad elected Autumn Sovereign of the Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: Leinore's younger sister, possessed by Saryth.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel whose unmaking broke the Cursemute.

events.summary: After Avacyn's unmaking the Cursemute broke and Leinore's werewolf mother left.
events.quote: the Cursemute broke, causing their mother to leave their family

events.summary: Sinnia wore a mask found in the forest and was possessed by Saryth.
events.quote: Sinnia wore the mask and ended up possessed by the powers of the witch Saryth

events.summary: Leinore and Katilda impeded the ritual to summon the Coiled One and saved Sinnia.
events.quote: The ritual was impeded by Leinore and Katilda, and they were able to save Sinnia.

relations.quote: Leinore's and her younger sister Sinnia 's mother was a werewolf
